watches.name: ScrewDiver
watches.description: 40mm dive watch with a hand-cut Charoite stone dial — a nod to DJ Screw, slowed down and turned up.

Every marker and every Mr. Eatwell logo is placed by hand on the stone, one piece at a time.
A meaningful percentage of dials break in transit to us, and more break during assembly. Each finished watch represents several attempts.
Where a standard build is days, this can take weeks depending on stock and stone yield.
specsRaw.Note on stone: Charoite is a natural material; minor inclusions, color variation, and grain are features, not flaws. Stone breakage from impact is not covered.

watches.name: GMT Challenger
watches.description: Inspired by the soda underdog and the scrappy ingenuity it took to go head-to-head with a giant. NH34 GMT movement, frosted silver dial, red & blue GMT bezel.

specsRaw.So here’s my take: a GMT inspired by that soda—and the scrappy ingenuity it took to go head-to-head with a giant. A watch for those of us who don’t mind second place… as long as we got there on our own terms.

specsRaw.Mechanical Watches: These watches must be manually wound by turning the crown. The mainspring stores energy, which is gradually released to power the watch.
specsRaw.Automatic Watches: Also known as self-winding watches, these harness the natural motion of the wearer’s wrist to wind the mainspring. If you wear them regularly, you don’t need to wind them manually.
specsRaw.Mechanical/Automatic: Powered by a mainspring and gears.
specsRaw.Automatic: If worn consistently, the motion of your wrist will load the spring and keep it running. May need occasional servicing.

watches.name: Half-Lime
watches.description: Some watches whisper. The Half-Lime walks into the room in a lime green dial and lets everyone else adjust. It's the SubLime's textured lime dial and polished bezel, slimmed to 36mm or 39mm, so it slips under a cuff and ruins the cuff's whole plan. Automatic, with a Japanese NH35 or a Swiss Sellita SW200-1, and a display caseback because the movement is half the fun. Hand-assembled in Portland, Oregon. Jubilee, Oyster, Presidential, or lime stingray leather, all the same price. The newest addition to our Dress-to-Impress line, for people who'd rather be noticed than approved of.
